q: Kivvers would bite at just about anything dropped into the water. I remember how my friend Donny once snagged three or four with a small safety pin jiggled back and forth in front of their faces.
An' when they turn't the kivvers down, he wasn't there at all!
1886, James Whitcomb Riley, “The Elf Child”, in The Boss Girl. A Christmas Story and Other Sketches, page 178:

e: Imitative of its notes. From a Polynesian language.
